votes.evidence:
I read the code at bc7090d and reproduced the claim with a test server and a control.

Code paths:
- schemaWalk.ts resolvedNode only follows `$ref` chains and never looks inside anyOf/oneOf.
- enumValues does skip a bare {type:'null'} branch. A {$ref:'#/$defs/E'} branch has neither const nor enum, so it sets closed=false and adds no values. The function then returns undefined, even with open:true, because the value list is empty.
- data.ts isNonText reads only node.type. orResolved only resolves a top-level `$ref`, so {anyOf:[{type:integer},{type:null}]} is not treated as non-text and the WEAK_CONVO warning fires.
- annotations.ts TOOL-015: freeForm(n) is true because the anyOf node has no type, enum or pattern. resolvedNode(n) returns n unchanged and enumValues(n) is undefined, so free=true.
- tools.ts isFreeString: type is undefined, there is no `$ref` at the top level, and listedValues is undefined, so it returns true. This affects TOOL-023, TOOL-025 and TOOL-026.
- TOOL-025 fires at its default chatgpt 'error' when a discovery tool and a free-form object property are also present.

I found no guard elsewhere that prevents this.

Run: I built a detached worktree at bc7090d and wrote a raw stdio JSON-RPC server (scratchpad opt-server.mjs) that uses the pydantic shapes. `node dist/cli.js --stdio -- node opt-server.mjs` printed:
- DATA-001 on get_weather /properties/history (anyOf integer|null)
- DATA-001 on get_weather /properties/memory (anyOf integer|null)
- TOOL-015 run_command, free-form "url" (anyOf [$ref enum of 2 URLs, null])
- TOOL-025 run_command, generic executor with free-form "command" (anyOf [$ref enum deploy|rollback, null])

Control: the same server with the Optional wrappers removed (plain integer and a direct `$ref`) produced none of these findings.

Severity: medium. These are false warnings on the most common Python and zod Optional pattern, and TOOL-025 becomes a false ChatGPT error in the dispatcher case. I removed the worktree afterwards.

Built bc7090d in a detached worktree (since removed). Wrote a low-level SDK stdio server that serves raw JSON Schemas in the Pydantic v2 shape, with an argv switch that turns the Optional wrapper on or off. Ran `node dist/cli.js --local --stdio -- node opt-server.mjs <1|0>`.

With the wrapper `{anyOf:[X,{type:'null'}],default:null}`, it produced these four findings:
- DATA-001 warning on get_weather /properties/history, where X is `{type:integer}`
- DATA-001 warning on get_weather /properties/memory, where X is `{type:integer}`
- TOOL-025 warning "generic executor with free-form \"command\"", where X is `{$ref:'#/$defs/Cmd'}` and Cmd has enum deploy|rollback
- TOOL-015 "openWorldHint: false but free-form \"url\"", where X is a `$ref` to an enum of 2 URLs. This one appears once openWorldHint is false.

The control run uses the same schemas without the wrapper (plain integer, or the bare `$ref` enum). It produced none of these findings, so the wrapper alone causes them.

Code at bc7090d matches the claimed cause:
- `resolvedNode` follows only `$ref` and never looks inside anyOf/oneOf.
- `enumValues` sets closed=false on a `{$ref}` branch. `isFreeString` (tools.ts) depends on `listedValues` (`enumValues` with open:true), so a `{$ref}`+null anyOf returns undefined and the parameter counts as free.
- `isNonText` (data.ts:59) reads only `node.type`, and the anyOf node has no `type`.

The four findings are heuristic warnings, so medium is the right severity. Medium also covers the TOOL-025 path that becomes a ChatGPT error when a discovery tool sits next to it, plus TOOL-023/026, which share `isFreeString`. Pydantic and FastMCP emit this shape for every Optional field, so it is common.

Not a duplicate: grep for nullable/anyOf-null/Optional finds nothing in round 1 or round 3 FINDINGS, REMEDIATION or CHANGELOG.
